sites.title: Sites
sites.subtitle: Every website this installation hosts.

empty.title: No sites yet
empty.body: Create the first site to get started. A site needs a name and at least one host name.

create.title: Create a site
create.name: Site name
create.hostNameHelp: The domain visitors will use. No port, no scheme.
create.languageHelp: The language of the site's content. You can change it later.

noAccess.title: No access yet
noAccess.body: You are signed in, but you have no role on any site yet. Ask an administrator to give you access.

sites.httpBadgeLabel: Uses HTTP: links to this site are not secure

detail.disabledNotice: This site is disabled. Visitors see "not found" at all of its host names. You can keep working on it here.
detail.readOnly: You can view this site's settings. Only an administrator can change them.

settings.heading: Settings
settings.name: Site name
settings.httpWarning: Links to this site will use HTTP, which is not secure. Use HTTPS unless the site is only reachable on a private network.
settings.primaryHelp: The base URL uses this host name.
settings.outOfDate: Someone else changed this site while you were editing. Reload to see their changes, then make yours again.

hostNames.heading: Host names
hostNames.help: Every host name here reaches this site. A host name can belong to only one site.
hostNames.addHelp: A domain such as example.com, without a scheme, port or path.
hostNames.cannotRemovePrimary: The primary host name can't be removed. Make another one primary first.
hostNames.cannotRemoveLast: A site keeps at least one host name.
hostNames.confirmBody: Visitors using this host name will no longer reach the site, and another site can then use it.
hostNames.primaryChanged: {host} is now the primary host name.

availability.heading: Availability
availability.enabledBody: This site is online. Visitors reach it at its host names.
availability.disabledBody: This site is offline. Visitors see "not found" at its host names. Its content, settings and host names are kept.
availability.confirmDisableBody: Visitors will see "not found" at every host name of this site, as if it did not exist. Nothing is deleted, and you can enable it again at any time.
availability.confirmEnableBody: Visitors will reach this site again at its host names.

errors.host_name_taken: That host name is already in use.
errors.invalid_host_name: That is not a valid host name. Use a domain such as example.com, without a scheme, port or path.
errors.host_name_not_found: This site no longer has that host name.
errors.primary_host_name_removal: The primary host name can't be removed. Make another one primary first.
errors.last_host_name: A site keeps at least one host name.
errors.primary_host_name_invalid: The primary host name must be one of this site's host names.
errors.invalid_scheme: The scheme must be HTTPS or HTTP.
errors.invalid_name: A site name must be between 1 and 200 characters.
errors.out_of_date: Someone else changed this site at the same time. Reload it and try again.
errors.not_found: This site no longer exists, or you can no longer see it.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.

media.title: Media — {site}
media.subtitle: Images and PDFs for this site. Files are served from the site’s own addresses.

empty.title: No files yet
empty.body: Upload images or PDFs to use them on this site.

media.noHost: This site has no host name yet. Its files will be reachable at a public address once it has one.

upload.heading: Upload files
upload.notice: Uploaded files are public straight away: anyone with the address can open them. Details embedded in a file, such as where a photo was taken, are published unchanged with it.
upload.types: JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, AVIF or PDF.

errors.file_name_required: The file has no usable name.
errors.type_mismatch: The file’s name or type does not match its contents.
errors.too_large: The file is larger than the limit.
errors.unsupported_type: This type of file is not allowed. Use JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, AVIF or PDF.
errors.storage_unavailable: The file could not be stored. Try again.
errors.storage_full: The storage location is full. Ask an administrator.
errors.unknown: The file could not be uploaded.

delete.label: Delete {name}
delete.title: Delete {name}?
delete.body: This is permanent. The file stops being served straight away and cannot be restored.

pages.heading: Pages
pages.intro: The page structure of {site}. Addresses are built from each page's slug and its parents'.
pages.empty: This site has no pages yet. Add the home page to start.
pages.readOnly: You can view this site's pages. Only a designer can change their structure.

actions.heading: Selected page: {title}
actions.none: Select a page to see what you can do with it.

details.heading: Draft
details.editorLater: The content of pages is edited in the visual editor, which is not available yet.

form.title: Title
form.slugHelp: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. The address will be {address}.
form.slugInvalid: Use lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, without a hyphen at the start or end.
form.isHome: This is the home page (its address is /)

confirm.deleteBody: The page {address} and its draft are deleted permanently. There is no undo.
confirm.makeHomeBody: {title} will be at /, and the current home page will move to its own address. Addresses under both pages change too.

pages.outOfDate: Someone else changed this page while you were working. Reload to see their changes, then try again.

errors.invalid: Check the title and slug and try again.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this on this site.
errors.invalid_title: A title must be between 1 and 200 characters.
errors.invalid_slug: Use lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, without a hyphen at the start or end.
errors.duplicate_address: Another page already has this address. {detail}
errors.reserved_address: This address is reserved by the platform. Choose another slug.
errors.address_too_long: The address would be too long.
errors.too_deep: Pages can be nested at most 10 levels deep.
errors.too_many_pages: This site already has the most pages it can hold (2,000).
errors.move_into_descendant: A page cannot be moved under itself or one of its own pages.
errors.parent_not_found: That page no longer exists. Reload and try again.
errors.home_page_exists: This site already has a home page. Use "Make home page" instead.
errors.home_page_must_be_top_level: The home page must be a top-level page.
errors.has_children: This page has {count} child page(s). Move or delete them first.
errors.home_page: The home page cannot be deleted while the site has other pages. Make another page the home page first.
errors.out_of_date: Someone else changed this page while you were working. Reload and try again.
errors.not_found: That page no longer exists. Reload and try again.
errors.component_not_found: That component no longer exists. Reload and try again.
errors.invalid_component_name: A component name must be between 1 and 100 characters.
errors.duplicate_component_name: This site already has a component with that name.
errors.component_in_use: This component is used by {count} page(s). Remove it from them first.

components.heading: Shared components
components.intro: Pieces such as a header or footer that many pages of {site} reuse. Pages refer to a component, so changing it once changes it everywhere.
components.empty: This site has no shared components yet.
components.readOnly: You can view this site's components. Only a designer can change them.

confirm.deleteBody: The component and its draft are deleted permanently. There is no undo.

settings.title: Settings
settings.placeholder: Settings arrive with a later feature.

setup.title: Set up QuickBuilder
setup.intro: Create the first administrator for this installation. You only do this once.
setup.codeHelp: Printed in the application's console output when it starts. With the reference deployment, run: docker compose logs app
setup.passwordHelp: 12 to 128 characters. A few unrelated words make a strong, memorable password.

errors.invalid: Some details need attention. See the messages below each field.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.

identity.setup_code_invalid: That setup code is not correct. Copy it again from the console output.
identity.setup_already_completed: This installation has already been set up.
identity.https_required: For your security, sign-in only works over HTTPS, or from the machine running QuickBuilder.
identity.throttled: Too many attempts. Wait {seconds} seconds, then try again.
identity.invalid_credentials: That email address and password do not match an account.
identity.email_taken: Another account already uses that email address.
identity.last_administrator: This would leave nobody able to manage the installation. Make someone else an administrator first.
identity.user_deactivated: This account is deactivated. Reactivate it first.
identity.current_password_incorrect: Your current password is not correct.
identity.link_invalid: This link can't be used. Ask an administrator for a new one.
identity.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.

errors.missing: Enter your email address and password.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Everyone who can sign in to this installation.

link.title: Set-password link for {name}
link.onceOnly: This link is shown once. Copy it now and send it to the user yourself — QuickBuilder does not send email.
link.label: Link

edit.emailWarning: Changing the email address signs this user out everywhere; they sign in with the new address.
edit.rolesSaved: Roles saved. They apply on the user's next request.
edit.linkIssued: New link issued. Any earlier link no longer works.
edit.deactivated: Deactivated. The user was signed out.

grants.administratorHelp: Administrators manage users and every site. Site roles do not apply to them.

setPassword.title: Choose your password
setPassword.invalid: This link can't be used. It may have been used already, expired, or been replaced. Ask an administrator for a new one.
setPassword.done: Your password is set. You can sign in now.

account.title: Your account
account.nextHelp: 12 to 128 characters. Changing it signs you out everywhere else.
account.passwordChanged: Password changed. Your other sessions were signed out.
account.sessionsHelp: Signed in somewhere you no longer use? End every session except this one.
account.othersSignedOut: Your other sessions were signed out.
